messages:
Lina: I'm prototyping a "compact trace" mode for the error inspector. Idea: collapse function groups by module, show a small persistent correlation-id chip at top/right, and add a single 'Export' action that opens a modal with format choices. Quick gut-check? :mag:

Tom: Sounds useful. Can we make collapse state per-module persistent (local storage) so users don't reopen the same trace and lose context? Also, when collapsed, show a count badge like '12 frames' so it's obvious there's hidden content.

Priya: A11y: collapsed regions need aria-controls -> id and an accessible label like 'Expand frames for module <name>'. Use role="button" for the toggle and ensure focus indicator meets contrast. Prefer left-side toggles in DOM order so keyboard users hit them first.

Tom: UX copy thought: the correlation chip should show a truncated id (first 8 chars) with a tooltip for the full value and a small copy button. Tooltip copy text: 'Copy correlation id'.

DevOpsBot: FYI: traces for batch requests sometimes include internal KV dumps. We should default to excluding KV cache in exports. If users enable it, add an explicit inline warning: 'Including KV may contain sensitive keys.'

Lina: For the export modal I'm thinking three radio options: 1) Compact CSV (one row per exception), 2) Pretty JSON (suitable for sharing), 3) Stream JSONL (for very large traces). Show an approximate download size next to each option.

Priya: When Stream JSONL is selected, ensure the modal warns about very large downloads and that focus is trapped while the streaming prompt runs. Also keyboard users should be able to cancel with Escape and the stream should abort cleanly.
